name: TrendMeLeaveMe
summary: TrendMeLeaveMe is a trend-following Expert Advisor that enters trades in the direction of the prevailing trend using moving average-based signals and exits when the trend shows signs of exhaustion or reversal. It employs a combination of trend identification and dynamic exit logic to capture sustained directional moves while attempting to leave the trade before the trend reverses.
summary_zh: TrendMeLeaveMe是一个趋势跟踪型EA，基于均线信号判断当前趋势方向并顺势入场，当趋势出现衰竭或反转迹象时退出交易。它结合趋势识别和动态出场逻辑，旨在捕捉持续的方向性行情并在趋势反转前离场。
strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略概念是基于移动均线的趋势跟踪，通过判断价格与均线的关系或多条均线的排列来确认趋势方向。入场条件通常为价格突破均线或短期均线上穿长期均线时顺势开仓。出场条件则依赖于趋势反转信号，如价格回落跌破均线或均线交叉反转时平仓。仓位管理方面，EA允许用户设置固定手数或基于资金比例的仓位计算方式。资金管理方面提供了止损和止盈参数，但具体的止损设置是否合理取决于参数配置。整体策略逻辑清晰，但作为趋势跟踪系统，在震荡行情中可能产生频繁的虚假信号导致连续亏损。
strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy concept of this EA is trend following based on moving averages, confirming trend direction by evaluating price position relative to moving averages or the alignment of multiple moving averages. Entry conditions typically involve price breaking through a moving average or a short-term MA crossing above a long-term MA, opening positions in the trend direction. Exit conditions rely on trend reversal signals such as price falling back below the moving average or a bearish MA crossover. Position sizing allows users to configure fixed lot sizes or percentage-based lot calculation. Money management provides stop loss and take profit parameters, though the effectiveness of stop loss settings depends on user configuration. The overall strategy logic is clear, but as a trend-following system, it may generate frequent false signals during ranging markets leading to consecutive losses.

parameters.description_en: Take profit in points, 0 means no take profit

parameters.description: 追踪止损点数，0表示不启用
parameters.description_en: Trailing stop in points, 0 to disable

pros: 策略逻辑简单清晰，基于均线趋势跟踪易于理解和验证
提供追踪止损功能，可在趋势行情中锁定浮动利润
参数可配置性强，用户可根据不同品种和周期调整均线参数
顺势交易理念正确，趋势行情中有较好的盈利潜力
pros_en: Strategy logic is simple and clear, based on MA trend following which is easy to understand and verify
Provides trailing stop functionality to lock in floating profits during trending markets
Highly configurable parameters allow users to adjust MA settings for different instruments and timeframes
Trend-following philosophy is sound with good profit potential in trending markets
cons: 趋势跟踪系统在震荡行情中容易产生频繁的虚假信号导致连续亏损
止损默认为0存在较大风险，用户若不设置止损可能面临巨大亏损
缺乏市场状态过滤机制，无法区分趋势行情和震荡行情
缺少新K线检查机制，可能在同一根K线上反复开仓
仓位管理较为简单，缺乏基于波动率的动态仓位调整
cons_en: Trend-following systems prone to frequent false signals and consecutive losses in ranging markets
Default stop loss of 0 poses significant risk; users may face large losses without setting SL
Lacks market regime filter to distinguish between trending and ranging conditions
Missing new bar check mechanism may cause repeated trade entries on the same bar
Position sizing is simplistic without volatility-based dynamic adjustment
improvements: 增加市场状态过滤器（如ADX指标）来区分趋势行情和震荡行情，避免在震荡中频繁交易
添加波动率自适应止损机制，根据ATR动态调整止损距离而非使用固定点数
improvements_en: Add a market regime filter (e.g., ADX indicator) to distinguish trending from ranging markets and avoid excessive trading in choppy conditions
Implement volatility-adaptive stop loss using ATR to dynamically adjust stop distance instead of fixed pip values

risk_points: 止损默认值为0，若用户未手动设置止损则存在无限亏损风险
缺少新K线检查机制，可能在同一根K线上重复开仓导致仓位过重
趋势跟踪策略在震荡行情中会产生连续亏损，缺乏有效过滤
risk_points_en: Default stop loss of 0 creates unlimited loss risk if user fails to manually configure SL
Missing new bar check may cause duplicate entries on the same bar leading to oversized positions
Trend-following strategy generates consecutive losses in ranging markets without effective filtering

It employs a combination of trend identification and dynamic exit logic to capture sustained directional moves while attempting to leave the trade before the trend reverses.
